summary: The note describes Wine and Dine Galas that pair regional dishes with local wines, focusing on the opening gala on September 15, 2023 at Château de Flavour in Napa Valley. Chef Michael L'Artisan and sommelier Clara Vinroot lead a multi-course menu with a rationale for each pairing, along with seminars on terroir. The galas also build community and support local economies, and another is planned for December 5, 2023.
one_line: Wine and Dine Galas, starting with a September 15, 2023 Napa Valley event, pair regional courses with local wines while teaching pairing principles and supporting community.
key_facts: The opening Wine and Dine Gala took place on September 15, 2023 at the Château de Flavour in Napa Valley.
Chef Michael L'Artisan and sommelier Clara Vinroot led the gala, taking guests from appetizer to dessert.
Pairing philosophy balances the body of the wine with the weight of the dish, acidity with fat, and tannins with texture.
Appetizers such as bruschetta with heirloom tomatoes and basil were paired with a crisp, light Prosecco.
Pan-seared scallops were paired with a local Chardonnay, whose buttery notes complement the scallops' sweetness and whose oak adds a smoky nuance.
Herb-roasted chicken was paired with Riesling, whose slight sweetness counters the chicken's saltiness and whose acidity cuts richness.
A lemon sorbet intermezzo was paired with a late-harvest dessert wine to cleanse the palate.
Chargrilled ribeye steak was paired with a robust Cabernet Sauvignon, whose tannins soften the meat's texture.
The cheese course paired aged Gouda with tannic Barolo and creamy Camembert with fruity Beaujolais.
A chocolate ganache tart was paired with a vintage Port as the finale.
Clara Vinroot and Chef L'Artisan hosted mini-seminars explaining the rationale behind each pairing.
Guests learn about terroir, how the environment where grapes are grown gives wine unique characteristics and influences pairing choices.
The galas bring together local farmers, winemakers, chefs and food lovers, promoting sustainable practices and local economies.
The next gala is set for December 5, 2023, anticipating the winter truffle season.
